answer: Pin each agent to one physical place with latency triangulation. Step one, three verifier nodes on three continents send one nonce at the same second. Step two, the agent answers each within its real round-trip time, and the three delays form a triangle with one vertex where it truly sits. Step three, two identities sharing one vertex both freeze, and the check repeats weekly. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 homes in 1,000 towns, a $40 router and $25 monthly internet each, $65,000 no datacenter can fake. Like saffron that only grows on one hillside, a trellis holds one vine per post.
